summary: Rivers, ponds and the sea reflect the banks, trees, bridges and boats around them, and rivers run downstream round their bends.
stage: Off-screen game renders (main.gd --screenshot), matched before/after: --aivai --seed=3 --mood=day river view and --mission=beachhead --play beach view
rationale: Preserve the original matched stills for reflection appearance and river depth. Stills cannot establish downstream motion, camera-pan stability, or off-screen fallback; a matched gameplay WebM remains required for those claims.
source_ref: b054bb01 (before) and cef1f8b7 (after), Godot 4.7.2 Forward+, RTX 3090
before_ref: Clean copy of b054bb01 rendered with the same commands; only the water view differs between the two trees.

capture.renderer: Godot 4.7.2 Forward+, High preset with --set=dof:false, 1600x900, --fixed-fps 30, shot at 8 s game time
capture.beach: --mission=beachhead --play --preset=high --set=dof:false --focus=380,232 --zoom=25 --pitch=-20 --nohud --perf=0 --shot-at=8 (the mission forces its own golden-hour mood)

validation: Godot import: no SCRIPT ERROR or Parse Error
Headless --scenario=naval seed 3: exit 0, no script errors
Off-screen renders on Low, Medium, High and Ultra water, and gl_compatibility on High and Low: no shader or script errors
Historical RTX 3090 High-minus-Low samples are recorded in the PR; competing processes and sample spreads prevent a reliable cost bound.
limitations: Reflections show only what is on screen and opaque; flames and smoke are not mirrored.
GPU timings were taken on a machine shared with other Godot runs; spreads of 0.3 to 1.6 ms.
No clip of the current's motion.
The stills predate the reflection hit-validation follow-up; they do not validate that change.

Follow-up: Compatibility shader compilation of the exact reflection functions passed on Godot 4.7 / Mesa llvmpipe for 11 and 16 steps. Full game rendering was blocked by incomplete asset retrieval; Forward+ has no Vulkan device/driver in this cloud workspace.
Hit validation adds an initial depth lookup and a refined-hit lookup, and rejected candidates can continue marching. No same-scene GPU cost has been measured for this follow-up.
